description: This file defines a Python class for representing and parsing Android.mk makefiles, including methods for extracting variables, includes, and checking for specific build configurations.

classes.name: AndroidMK
classes.description: A class that models an Android.mk file, allowing parsing and querying of makefile variables and includes.

methods.name: _ProcessMKLine
methods.description: Processes a line from the makefile to extract includes or variables.

methods.name: GetVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a makefile variable.

methods.name: GetExpandedVariable
methods.description: Recursively expands a variable to its literal value, resolving references.

methods.name: __RecursiveGetVariable
methods.description: Helper method for recursive variable expansion, detects loops.

methods.name: HasInclude
methods.description: Checks if a specific include is present in the makefile.

methods.name: IncludesMakefilesUnder
methods.description: Checks if the makefile includes other makefiles under the current path.

methods.name: HasJavaLibrary
methods.description: Checks if a specific Java library is included in the makefile.

methods.name: HasGTest
methods.description: Checks if the makefile includes rules to build GTest.

methods.name: _ParseMK
methods.description: Parses the Android.mk file at a given path.
